## Checklist | 检查清单

<!-- Check all that apply before submitting -->
<!-- 提交前请检查所有适用项 -->

- [ ] My code follows the project's coding style | 代码符合项目编码规范
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code | 已进行代码自查
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas | 已添加注释，特别是在难以理解的地方
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly | 已相应更新文档
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings | 更改不会产生新的警告
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works | 已添加测试证明修复有效或功能可用
- [ ] New and existing tests pass locally | 新旧测试在本地都通过
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published | 已合并并发布所有依赖的更改
